topic: Using EMMA - Researching Municipal Securities and 529 Plans
subtopic: Trade Prices, Yields, and Trading History
source_evidence: Trade prices, yields and other data about a bond’s trading history
answer: EMMA provides public access to trade prices, yields, and other information about a municipal bond’s trading history. This information can help you research the bond’s past trading activity. It is one of the types of bond-specific data available on EMMA.
